purpose: Minimal run-log register for the wiki's standing scheduled jobs, defined as data by Marathon R9 lane BA (tau-bench pass^k board item) because no single canonical run-log register existed in the wiki: sweep reports are prose in wiki/log.md and scheduler run history lives outside the wiki's registers. scripts/wiki_job_reliability.py computes the pass^k reliability line (successes over the last k runs, all-must-pass flagged) from this register, reporting only.
seed_note: Seeded EMPTY-BUT-VALID: this header is the whole register. No run records are backfilled or invented here — populating the register from the scheduler's own records is operational use, a separate act from this build.

shape.detail: string, optional: one line on the run (a failure's reason, a delivery's id)
shape.job: string, required: the scheduled job's name
shape.run_id: string, required: unique per run of that job
shape.started: string, required: ISO date or datetime the run started; runs are ordered by (started, run_id)
